cards.text: Jesus and His disciples head out to the villages around Caesarea Philippi, and on the way He asks them, "Who do people say I am?" Basically, what's the word on the street? And friend, they are ON the street.

cards.question: The disciples tell Jesus what people are saying about Him. Which name is on their list?

cards.text: Yep, some say John the Baptist, the one who baptized people in the wilderness (Mark 1:4). Others say Elijah, the prophet from long ago (1 Kings 18:36), and still others say one of the prophets.
Then Jesus asks, "But what about you?" and "Who do you say I am?" Ohhh, now it's the boss going around the meeting table, and it just landed on YOU.

cards.question: Jesus asks the disciples who THEY say He is. One of His twelve disciples (Mark 3:14-16) answers. Which one?
Peter gives Jesus his answer. Peter says Jesus is the ___.
Peter just said Jesus is the Christ. True or false: Jesus tells the disciples to go tell everyone.

cards.text: Then Jesus begins to teach them about the Son of Man, and He says some things MUST happen. Not might, not maybe, MUST.

cards.question: What does Jesus say must happen to the Son of Man?

answers.text: He must suffer and be killed
He must be crowned in Jerusalem
He must stay hidden from Herod

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man must suffer many things, be rejected by the elders, chief priests and scribes, and be killed. But He isn't done. What does He say happens after three days?

cards.text: Jesus says all this "quite frankly," and Peter takes Him aside. Friend, you know that move: the "Hey, got a sec?" walk down the hallway.

cards.question: Peter has Jesus off to the side. Mark sums up what happens next: Peter begins to ___ Him.

cards.text: But Jesus turns, looks at His disciples, and rebukes Peter: "Get behind Me, Satan!" Peter went from the big answer to THIS in four verses, like nailing the morning presentation and getting called into the boss's office by lunch.

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter he does not have in mind the things of God, but the things of ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus calls the crowd over, along with His disciples. EVERYBODY gets this one, and it's about what it takes to come after Him.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd and His disciples what anyone who wants to come after Him must do. Which of these is one of the things He names?

cards.text: Deny himself, and Jesus says he must also "take up his cross and follow Me." No free trial, no cancel-anytime button, friend: this is ALL in.

cards.question: Jesus has just told the crowd to deny themselves. True or false: He says whoever wants to save his life will keep it.

cards.text: Nope: whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for Jesus' sake and for the gospel will save it. Lose it to save it, save it to lose it, and I read that FIVE times, friend, because the stamper brain needed a minute.
Then Jesus asks, "What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?" Picture it: the corner office, the big promotion, the WHOLE WORLD in your pocket.

cards.question: Jesus follows up: "Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?" What's the point of His two questions?

answers.text: Nothing is worth trading your soul for
The whole world is worth the risk
Hard work can buy your soul back

cards.text: Then Jesus speaks about anyone who is ashamed of Him and His words in this adulterous and sinful generation. This is one of those moments where the whole bakery goes quiet, friend.

cards.question: If anyone is ashamed of Jesus and His words, what does Jesus say the Son of Man will do when He comes?
True or false: Jesus says the Son of Man will come in His Father's glory with the holy angels.

cards.text: Then Jesus opens with "Truly I tell you" and has one more thing to tell them. When Jesus opens like that, friend, you put the cookie DOWN and lean in.

cards.question: Jesus says some of the people standing there will not taste death before they see something. What will they see?

answers.text: The kingdom of God arrive with power
The temple rebuilt in three days
